entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Razor formatting errors when attributes span multiple lines #86027
    18.13
  • [AI artifact audit] Broken placeholder links in VMR codeflow guidance #86023
  • Heavy lock contention in TokenMap.AddItem exacerbated under VBCSCompiler during concurrent builds #86006
  • Compiler crash (ArgumentOutOfRangeException 'position') emitting PDB for partial union whose case list is in a later file #86005
    18.13

Closed

  • Side effects of accessing an array element used as the receiver of an implicit Index indexer are observed out of order #85880
    Backlog
  • `VBCSCompiler` goes into infinite loop when trying to `dotnet build` #86003
  • Add predicate version of IOperation.Descendants #53621
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix DiagnosticDescription formatting for integer codes and stabilize TestMultiFile_EditTransitiveDirective #86029
    VSCode
  • Fix Razor multiline attribute directive formatting #86028
    Area-Razor
  • Migrate C# and Visual Basic options to Unified Settings #86026
  • Fix compiler crash for partial a union declaration #86025
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Replace broken placeholder links in VMR guidance #86024
  • Add AI-assisted issue reproduction via label #86022
  • Fix Generate Constructor crash when inspecting properties in referenced projects #86021
    VSCode
  • Unify ref safety analysis of embedded vs block statements #86019
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Ref Locals and Returns
  • Unsafe evolution: display `unsafe` in quick info #86018
    Area-IDE, IntelliSense-Quick Info, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Unsafe evolution: make address of uninitialized var unsafe #86017
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Handle stackalloc syntax in RemoveUnusedMembers analysis #86016
    Community, VSCode
  • Support custom snippet fields in Razor (and fix but) #86007
    Area-Razor
  • Avoid loading legacy Code Analysis for Error List commands #86004
    Community

Merged

  • Require fail-before/pass-after regression test evidence #86020
    Next
  • Add predicate version of IOperation.Descendants and DescendantsAndSelf #85898
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs API Review, Next
  • Observe side effects of accessing an array element used as the receiver of an implicit indexer in the right order #85973
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Don't copy generated file banners to new documents #85682
    Area-Razor
  • fix(analyzers): restrict NamedTypeFullNameNotNullSuppressor to C# #85998
    Area-Analyzers, Community
  • docs(banned-api): add package readme and bundle with NuGet package #85999
    Area-Analyzers, Documentation, Community
  • Parse `[...] = x` in with initializers as an indexer #85798
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Ensure unused BoundPassByCopy access evaluates all observable side effects #85986
    Area-Compilers
  • Implement OnDemand Project Loading #85805
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • [release/insiders] Backport ProjectData fixes to release/insiders #85990
  • Use assembly data for a collection expression that spreads `u8` literal #85911
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Add tests for ref returning function pointers #85949
  • Unsafe evolution: add csc flag and msbuild property #85980
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Indent list pattern contents relative to '[' when it starts its own line #85997
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Don't offer 'var' for an out argument when the call binds outside the checked member group #85996
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Don't track const locals in unused value analysis #85994
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Do not force a newline between } and , in switch expressions #85992
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Don't offer 'use pattern matching' when a local function writes the 'as' operand #85991
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Don't include the zero member when formatting a flags enum TypedConstant #85975
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • RoslynTools: handle snap commits #85843
  • Allow goto out of a block across a using declaration in that block #85993
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85960
  • Introduce a Razor DLL for `dotnet format`, and share formatting code #85963
    Area-Razor
